The '''Toxi-Trooper Brigade''' was a unit of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] that specialized in operating in hostile-environment battlefronts, such as the toxic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Yanus]] commanded the brigade, and sent a personal transfer offer to [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Raina Temple]], who had been flagged as hostile-environment capable after serving on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
